# `aitbc monitor webhooks`

Register, list, or remove monitoring webhooks.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc monitor webhooks [OPTIONS] ACTION
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | choice | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | no | Webhook name |
| `--url` | text | — | no | Webhook URL |
| `--events` | text | — | no | Comma-separated event types (job_completed,miner_offline,alert) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc monitor webhooks ACTION
```
